statutory_trace: ITAA 1936 s 109E(1): a private company is taken to pay a dividend at the end of the current year where an amalgamated loan made in an earlier year is not repaid and payments fall short of the minimum yearly repayment.
s 109E(5): the minimum yearly repayment is worked out using the formula in s 109E(6).

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 120000.00.
Current year's benchmark interest rate (2026-27, s 109N(2)) = 0.0877, from RBA table F5 series FILRHLBVS, 2026-05 figure.
Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 3.
MYR = (120000.00 x 0.0877) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0877)) ^ 3) = 47212.37 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 45000.00.
